scope: V28.6.9 Public Website / Global Search / RBAC / RLS foundational checks

commits.summary: Aligned Service Operations Live Core with production schema and wired create/update status transition logging.
Added static verifier for V28.6 Batch A Service Operations/Public/RBAC checks.

key_repairs: Service Operations Live Core selectors now match the V28.5/production schema alignment used by the full-chain API.
Quotation fields now use version, total_amount, currency and status instead of current_version, total and approval_status.
Invoice fields now use customer_id, job_id, quotation_id, total_amount, currency, status and visible_to_customer.
Payment fields now use invoice_id, customer_id, amount, currency, status and reconciled_at, avoiding deprecated fee usage.
Warranty fields now use starts_on and ends_on, and include customer_id, invoice_id, quotation_id, visible_to_customer and public_ref.
Status transition logs are attempted for Service Operations create paths through writeStatusTransitionLog.
Status transition logs are attempted for Service Operations update paths when the module status column changes.
Audit logs now record status_transition_logged for create/update actions, avoiding assumed success.

public_rbac_foundation_review.public_submit_route: app/api/service-requests/route.ts already writes unified_intake, leads and service_requests and fails explicitly when Supabase is not configured.
public_rbac_foundation_review.rbac_foundation: lib/apiSecurity.ts already resolves actor identity server-side through Supabase auth tokens, profiles/admin_profiles and default-disabled secret fallback.

remaining_work: Run node tools/verify-v28-6-2-service-ops-public-rbac.mjs locally/CI to generate runtime report output.
Run npm run validate:predeploy and npm run build:ci in CI/local because this connector cannot execute the repo build.
Continue Batch A with Global Search route-level review and public upload/storage binding review.
Do not apply customer_account_claims/customer_record_links RLS to production until preview/staging verification is complete.
safety_notes: No fake success or localStorage business-state fallback added.
